description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Emergence Zone by paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells as though they had flash this turn.
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.
